routes.opportunity: Azure for Students — US$100 cloud credit for 12 months
routes.assets: Any Active Research Project|Hardware Splicer|Research Drive|Cite|Nocturnal
routes.contribution_view: General-purpose Linux VM, containers, storage, databases and research/dev infrastructure
routes.gate: G1 verify current Azure-for-Students account/renewal state and active full-time student verification. Official terms provide US$100 for 12 months with no credit card and allow annual renewal while eligible; deployed services are decommissioned if credit expires/exhausts without upgrade.

routes.opportunity: Heroku for GitHub Students — US$13/month for 24 months
routes.contribution_view: Persistent APIs, workers, Dynos, Postgres and Key-Value Store
routes.gate: G1 active GitHub Student Developer Pack required. Credits total US$312 but burn down at US$13/month, do not roll over, and begin from the first day of the approval month; applying near the start of a month maximizes realized value.

routes.opportunity: Appwrite Education — two Pro-equivalent projects while student-verified
routes.contribution_view: Managed auth, database, storage and functions for educational/noncommercial projects
routes.gate: G1 active GitHub Student Developer Pack required. Education plan permits two projects with Pro-equivalent usage limits minus email support and remains valid through student status; official terms prohibit non-educational/commercial use, so paid pilots must not rely on this entitlement.

routes.opportunity: MongoDB Student Pack — US$50 Atlas credit + certification
routes.contribution_view: Database credit plus optional certification signal
routes.gate: G1 GitHub Student Developer Pack required. Atlas promo code expires if not applied within 90 days after generation and redemption requires a valid credit card or linked PayPal account; do not start the clock until a real MongoDB workload exists.

routes.opportunity: YZU campus-licensed software — Microsoft 365 A5, Office, Windows upgrades, SAS, MATLAB
routes.contribution_view: Cost displacement for research, analysis, writing and engineering software
routes.gate: G1 activate/download only within YZU license scope. Windows campus license is upgrade-only and KMS activation has renewal requirements; software is for eligible university users and may have product-specific scope restrictions.

routes.opportunity: YZU electronic research resources and databases
routes.contribution_view: Literature, finance/economics, engineering and computing databases before purchasing external equivalents
routes.gate: G1 audit and activate useful resources before external spend. The library catalogue is dynamic (134 database entries at the verified crawl); electronic resources are limited to personal academic research/teaching and prohibit commercial use or systematic bulk downloading.

routes.contribution_view: Electronics-domain safety evaluations for model-agnostic AI-to-hardware interfaces using MCP-like protocols and explicit physical authority boundaries
routes.gate: G1/G3 official preview targets scientific research labs, advanced manufacturers and stakeholders across science, robotics, electronics and manufacturing. Apply as a research/evaluation collaboration, not as a request for cash; verify whether individual/YZU-student affiliation is sufficient or whether a lab/institutional wrapper materially improves selection.

routes.opportunity: AI for Science — up to US$50,000 Claude credits per project
routes.contribution_view: Fund controlled experiments, benchmarks or compute-heavy scientific research rather than product hosting
routes.gate: G1/G3 Anthropic announced Aug 27 that any researcher may apply for up to US$50,000 in credits per project and expanded beyond life sciences. Do not encode the unverified 'first Monday/monthly Sep 7' cadence. If applying through university affiliation, obtain any institutional consents required by the program rules; credits are provisioned to the organization/account identified in the application. Hardware-Splicer must be framed as a real scientific evaluation/benchmark, not ordinary engineering hosting.

routes.opportunity: Academic Research Credits — faculty/postdoc up to US$5,000; PhD up to US$1,000
routes.contribution_view: Reproducible research warehouse using storage, BigQuery, compute and data-analysis services
routes.gate: G1 MSc students are explicitly ineligible. Taiwan is supported. Faculty/postdoctoral researchers may receive one award up to US$5,000; PhD students up to US$1,000/year. Route requires an eligible PI/applicant, research proposal, Google Cloud billing account and pricing-calculator estimate; decisions generally take 6-8 weeks. Credits are research-only, nontransferable and noncommercial.

routes.opportunity: Oracle for Research Project Award — variable OCI credits/resources
routes.contribution_view: Reproducible longitudinal research infrastructure, public research tool/database and cloud-compute milestones
routes.gate: G1/G2 current application is PI/institution-oriented and requests PI job title, institution email/address, project milestones, research impact, OCI necessity, public-tool/database output and anticipated publications. Award amount is not fixed and varies with documented usage requirements; do not invent an US$8k-12k request without a defensible OCI cost model. Additional institutional/legal signatures are required before credit activation.

routes.opportunity: Claude Team plan for scientists — free Standard seats / discounted Premium for one year
routes.contribution_view: Lab-level Claude/Claude Science access that displaces subscription spend and supports research workflows
routes.gate: G1 principal investigator or equivalent at an academic/nonprofit research institution must complete verification, then may add lab researchers. Anthropic announced 10,000 initial scientist seats: Standard seats free and Premium seats with 5x limits at US$15/month for up to one year. Do not rely on the unverified 5-7-business-day review claim.

routes.opportunity: AWS Cloud Credit for Research — graduate students may request up to US$5,000
routes.contribution_view: Cloud compute/storage for repeatable research, benchmarks or sharable research infrastructure
routes.gate: G1 AWS officially permits graduate/postgraduate/PhD students to apply and caps student requests at US$5,000, but explicitly says applications from the 'greater China region' cannot currently be processed. The official FAQ does not disambiguate Taiwan in that phrase; obtain written AWS confirmation before spending application effort.

overrides.gate: G1 active academic/research affiliation and supported API country. Official program offers up to US$1,000 API credits valid 12 months; applications are reviewed in March, June, September and December. No exact September cutoff is published, so apply early rather than inventing Sep 3-4 as a hard deadline. Use Cite/Citation/Policy research as a controlled study of responsible AI deployment, risk mitigation or societal impact.
overrides.contribution_view: Evidence-structured human-AI research measuring citation grounding, unsupported claims and corrective reliability
overrides.reason: Refresh Researcher Access economics, quarterly-review cadence and direct-researcher eligibility from current official sources.
